text:
Anya: Heads-up — starting a tiny canary for rwd-v2p4-quant4v3 in ~15m. Putting proposed gating + autoback thresholds here, please review :eyes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboard/rwd-v2p4-canary
Devon: Can you paste the metric snapshot and the exact rollback knobs?
Anya: Sure — quick paste of proposed gate JSON:
```json
{
  "p95_latency_ms": 1300,
  "p95_latency_delta_ms": 150,
  "hallucination_rate_delta_pct": 0.5,
  "slice_watchlist": ["longform>512", "code", "summarization"],
  "accept_rate_delta_pct": -1.0,
  "min_sample_size": 2000
}
```
Anya: Autoback rule idea: rollback if overall hallucination delta > 0.5% OR any watched slice delta > 0.25% with min samples. Also immediate rollback if p95 latency > 2x baseline or coldstart errors spike.
Maria: Suggest making p95 gate 1200ms for hosted-prod routes, keep 1300ms for dedicated. Hosted routes need tighter tail.
Kevin: Quick A/B summary from the 12.5k test: overall accept_rate delta = -0.6% (p=0.08), hallucination delta = +0.35% (p=0.04), p95 latency +90ms, median +12ms. Longform and code slices are the main contributors.
Sam: Which longform bucket — >512 or >1024?
Kevin: Mostly >1024. Code summarization slice shows +0.9% hallucination delta (n ~ 2.1k).
Anya: OK we should add slice-specific autoback: if watched_slice_hallucination_delta > 0.25% AND slice_n >= 500 => rollback that route's traffic. Global rollback stays at 0.5%.
qa-bot: Smoke checks ran: unit smoke=PASS (200/200), example-responses fuzz=WARNING (3/200 flagged) — details in run 2026-03-22T02:11Z
infra-bot: Routing update: canary opened at 3% traffic, fallback route pinned to rwd-v2p4-int8, autopromote disabled. KV-warmup enabled for longform route.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll hold promotion to 10% until we run targeted prompt eval for the code slice and confirm fixes.
Anya: Plan: 1) run targeted eval on 5k longform+code prompts (new seed set) 2) tune quantization config fallback (try remap for attention scaling) 3) re-run A/B with slice watchlist and preserved samples 4) re-evaluate gates after new data. I'll update the runbook and ping here when ready.
Devon: Thanks — ping me for the slice rollback toggle. Also consider lowering min_sample_size for watched slices to 500 to catch regressions quicker.
Anya: Good call. I'll set watched slice min_sample_size=500, global min=2000. Updating doc now.
Kevin: When we hit the 24h mark we should snapshot the concordance matrix and decide whether to allow manual promote.
Anya: Agreed. Will snapshot and post results. Thanks all.
